description: Permit ledger page 3 (scanned, handwritten entries): OCR's unreadable words are left out and reported, and its junk is never navigation (#83).

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the scanned page converts with no text.

A handwritten ledger has no heading.
